objective: Reduce wrong-root chord predictions while improving duration-weighted major/minor accuracy.
baseline: Unchanged long8192 STFT chroma, major/minor templates, frozen Viterbi penalty4 and RMS silence rule.

diagnostics: Root-only accuracy on supported reference chords; N predictions count as root errors

selection: Highest development majmin accuracy among candidates gaining at least0.5percentagepoints, improving root accuracy, and not reducing majmin accuracy in either progression family; ties prefer fewer feature components. No tuning from either previously evaluated test set.

heldout.source: IDMT archive dataset1 all88isolatedchordWAVs in bothChordsdirectories with pairedXML
heldout.scope: New recording session and isolated chord events; not a new-song/progression benchmark
heldout.annotations: Freeze filename-derived root/quality checked againstXML pitchclasses; score first annotatednoteonset throughlastnoteoffset
heldout.run: One frozen best-eligiblecandidate and originalbaseline; no modelscore before selection; fullfiletolabeltiming withsinglethread, orderseed20261109
heldout.promotion: Retain any validated improvement as a runnable optional frontend. Original song-comparison tables and default remain traceable; isolatedchordresults must not be stated as gains on unheard songs.

budget: Two independent branches and at most one evidence-motivated follow-up; stop after freshcomparison.

pre_evaluation_amendment.basis: Development-only fundamental projection gained6.06points overbaseline and trailedNNLSby0.34points. Include this fixed cheap control for a fair full-runtime tradeoff comparison. No new isolated-audio inference has occurred.
pre_evaluation_amendment.primary_candidate: fundamental-only NNLS, highest development major/minor accuracy
pre_evaluation_amendment.secondary_control: direct fundamental projection, no learned or selected parameter
pre_evaluation_amendment.heldout_comparisons: One frozen run of all88recordings withbaseline,selectedNNLS,anddirectprojection. Reportall3,withpairedinstrumentgroups; no retuning.
